attchmntText: Lorenzini Apparels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Monteil Limited, formerly Lorenzini Apparels Limited, submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. The statutory auditors, ADMS & Associates, issued a limited review report with an unmodified opinion. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 2,000.00 lakhs. The profit for the period was 216.44 lakhs. Earnings per equity share stood at 0.08. Total assets amounted to 10,225.72 lakhs. Equity was recorded at 5,360.89 lakhs. Net cash flow from operating activities was negative 353.18 lakhs. The company is seeking approval from the National Stock Exchange to change its trading symbol.
